current.text: The Clippers got him in the Kawhi Leonard trade with Toronto. He takes Kawhi's spot.
He has a partially torn Achilles, found during surgery in May. He is out now.
The newest expert view expects him back around Thanksgiving to Christmas, followed by minutes limits and rest. Other experts say no one knows when he returns or what restrictions he will have.
When healthy, experts see him as a starter and likely the Clippers' number one option. He and Garland should do nearly everything on offense, so his usage should rise, maybe toward 30%.
His assists may not rise because Garland is on the team.

Since the injury news, experts say to fade him. The newest call is not to draft him at his Yahoo rank of 83 or anywhere inside the top 120. Another expert says he is not a top 100 pick but is fine around 100 to 110 in stash-friendly formats.
He went for 6 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
Experts expect the Clippers to be one of the worst teams in the league.
The Clippers do not control their own draft pick, so tanking does not help them.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21. They have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.

durable.text: Over his last five seasons he played 55, 45, 64, 18 and 77 games. His minutes stayed between 32.9 and 34.2 in every one of them.
He is injury prone and a notoriously slow healer, so his games played are hard to project.
He is one of the better midrange scorers in the league. He rarely takes threes and has struggled with three-point volume and percentage.
He needs a lot of the ball and does little playing off the ball.
He is an average defender at best and gives poor defensive stats.
Points are his best category. Turnovers are his weakest category for his position.

note: He went for 16 USD in our league last season. Now he is out with a partially torn Achilles, and the newest expert view is to skip him inside the top 120. Yahoo still values him at 11 USD (rank 83), but the market is far lower: average costs are 2.5 USD on Yahoo and 3.6 USD on ESPN, and he went for 6 USD in an expert mock. We have 4 IL slots and a good 4-3-4 Clippers schedule in weeks 19 to 21, so he only makes sense as a 1 to 3 USD late stash in a build that can punt TO. Early in the season, watch for his return date (expected around Thanksgiving to Christmas) and for how long his minutes limit lasts.
